items.title: Luxury sales slump in China as tax crackdown hits wealthy shoppers
items.summary: China's top-25 luxury labels saw sales drop more than 10% in July 2026, worse than June, as Beijing tightens controls on cross-border stock trading and pursues back-taxes on offshore assets. Kering brands including Gucci, Bottega Veneta and Balenciaga posted double-digit declines alongside LVMH and Hermes; about 35% of Gucci's annual sales are China-exposed, a notably higher concentration than LVMH fashion/leather (~27%) or Hermes (~26%). Independent, quantified negative market signal, not activation coverage.

items.source: The Epoch Times (大紀元, Chinese edition)
items.title: 中共税收冲击下 中国奢侈品销售大幅下滑
items.summary: China luxury sales fell sharply amid the tax/capital-outflow crackdown: MSCI China index down 8.9% YTD, Macau casino revenue missed forecasts in June-July on reduced high-roller play, retail sales growth slowed to 0.6%. Domestic Chinese brands' share of category spend rose from 39% to 44%, and roughly 37% of surveyed Gen Z consumers plan to cut or halt luxury purchases. A Shanghai consultant is quoted describing VIP spending behavior as newly cautious. Corroborates item 001 with added consumer-sentiment detail; critical framing.

items.source: Qianlong Business Studies (新商学观察, via qianlong.com)
items.title: 古驰销售连跌12个季度，中国奢侈品消费正在发生什么改变？
items.summary: Chinese business-media analysis: Gucci has now posted 12 consecutive quarters of sales declines; Q2 2026 revenue was EUR 1.41 billion with the comparable decline narrowing to 2% from 8% in Q1. Frames this as still-fragile progress inside a structurally changed Chinese luxury consumption pattern (rising domestic-brand preference, more cautious VIP spend). Independent critical/analytical framing.

items.title: Kering Group Q2 Earnings 2026: Revenues Up 1% as Gucci Improves
items.summary: Kering group revenue returned to growth (EUR 3.65bn, +2% comparable) for Q2 2026. Gucci's comparable decline narrowed to 2% from 8% in Q1; new handbag launches (Borsetto, Paparazzo) and US demand (+9% in the quarter) cited as drivers, with Demna's design direction beginning to resonate with US consumers per the brand's Momentum Indicator ranking jumping from 26th to 6th. China remained the weakest region despite gradual improvement. Independent, quantified third-party reporting, eligible for full positive magnitude.

items.title: グッチが新作バッグ「ジャッキー フラップ」発売、ショルダーとクロスボディの2way仕様
items.summary: Gucci released the Jackie Flap bag from the Gucci Primavera FW2026 collection: GG-canvas version at 473,000 yen and handcrafted-leather version at 539,000 yen, 2-way shoulder/crossbody design. Purely descriptive product-launch announcement, no evaluative verdict from the outlet -- activation_coverage.

items.title: BTS 진 x 구찌(Gucci) 화보 풀렸는데 진짜 미쳤다는 말밖에 안 나옴
items.summary: Korean fan post reacting to a BTS Jin Gucci menswear editorial: praises Jin's presence as overpowering the brand's own glamour, calling the suiting and eye contact 'complete nobility'. Strong positive fandom reaction; per sentiment-rubric fandom trap, magnitude damped to 0.5 (ambassador/fan enthusiasm, not independent critical judgment). Engagement counts (likes/reposts) were not visible on the fetched page.

items.title: [2026 명품 트렌드] 명품의 핵심 소비국이 된 한국, 요즘은 가방보다 '주얼리'라고?
items.summary: Korean marketing-research community blog: Korean department stores report jewelry/watch sales surging in Q1 2026 (Shinsegae jewelry +55.6%, watches +36.9%; Lotte/Hyundai high-jewelry and watch categories +55% and +55.1% YoY) while overall spend rotates away from bags/RTW. Indirect negative signal for Gucci's core leather-goods category even as Korean luxury demand overall holds up.

items.title: 구찌 짭인지 봐주실분 ㅠ
items.summary: Korean forum user requests help authenticating a Gucci item they encountered, worried it may be counterfeit. Low-reach (83 views, 1 comment), routine authentication-request thread rather than a brand-sentiment statement; scored per rubric as neutral-to-mild-negative (counterfeit-inquiry trap) rather than a genuine opinion signal. Included to satisfy community-channel coverage; flagged as thin/low-signal.

items.title: 古驰在奢侈品行业处于什么地位？品牌价值138亿美元登顶意大利奢侈品牌第一
items.summary: Chinese financial-media piece citing Kantar BrandZ 2026: Gucci brand value at USD 13.8 billion, ranked first among Italian luxury brands. Neutral/factual industry-standing coverage, retained as the freshest available brand-value data point in the Chinese-language pool.
